tools.name: get_spot_prices
tools.description: Current spot prices per troy ounce in USD for gold, silver, platinum and palladium, as used by Bullion Trading LLC: the Ask (what our prices and premiums are measured over) and the Bid (what buy-back rates start from), with the change since the previous 5 pm New York close. Use when the user asks for the current gold, silver, platinum or palladium price. Read-only.

metals.description: Metals to return; default all four

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Bullion Trading LLC catalog of gold, silver, platinum and palladium coins, bars and rounds. Filter by metal, type, price range and stock; sort by price, popularity or newest. Returns both prices (check/wire and card/PayPal, +5%) and in/out of stock. Use when the user wants to find or compare Bullion Trading LLC products. Read-only; it cannot add to a cart or place an order.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "American Eagle" or "10 oz bar"

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product by id, slug or product URL: both prices, quantity price tiers, in/out of stock, metal, weight, purity, mint, a short description, what we pay to buy it back (if we do) and a price-history link. Use when the user asks about one specific Bullion Trading LLC product. Read-only.

product.description: Product id (e.g. 18707), slug, or https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/… URL

tools.name: find_bullion
tools.description: The "Find your bullion" picker: products matching a metal, form, size, purpose or sort order, as on bulliontradingllc.com/find-your-bullion/, with both prices, in/out of stock and the best price per ounce. Sizes look like "1-oz", "1-10-oz", "10-oz", "1-kilo", "1-gram". Use when the user describes what they want (metal, form, size, budget) and needs matching Bullion Trading LLC products. Read-only.

purpose.description: first purchase, a gift, or building a stack

sort.description: best pick, unit price, price per ounce, or premium over spot

state.description: Delivery state, for state shipping rules

tools.name: get_premiums
tools.description: Today's typical and lowest premium over the Ask spot for each standard coin and bar format (1 oz gold coins, 1 oz gold bars, silver rounds, kilo bars…) at Bullion Trading LLC, with the 2-year median and the lowest-premium product. Use when the user asks how far Bullion Trading LLC prices sit above spot, by format. Read-only.

tools.name: get_buyback_price
tools.description: What Bullion Trading LLC pays when you sell bullion to us: posted per-item rates (gold, platinum and palladium at spot bid minus 3% for popular items and items we sell, minus 5% for other items; silver at spot bid minus $3 per oz for popular and current items, minus $5 for items we don't usually deal in). Posted rates, not locked quotes. $1,000 minimum per sale. For a whole lot, or items described in words, use estimate_sell. Use when the user asks what Bullion Trading LLC pays to buy an item back. Read-only; posted rates, not a locked quote.

search.description: Words in the item name, e.g. "Maple Leaf"

tools.name: estimate_sales_tax
tools.description: Whether a US state charges sales tax on bullion, the threshold if any, and an estimate for an order amount. Estimate only; the final tax is shown at checkout. Includes the state page link. Use when the user asks about US sales tax on a bullion purchase. Read-only; not tax advice.

state.description: US state: 2-letter code (NY) or name (New York)

form.description: Product form; some states tax coins and bars differently

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Bullion Trading LLC contact and location: address on West 47th Street (New York), phone, emails, opening hours (New York time), year founded, licensing and map link. Use when the user asks about Bullion Trading LLC's address, hours, contact or licence. Read-only.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Bullion Trading LLC policies in the store's own wording: shipping (US only), payment methods and limits, returns, state minimums, NYC pickup, and selling to us. Use when the user asks about Bullion Trading LLC's shipping, returns, payment or ordering policies. Read-only.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Products on the Bullion Trading LLC deals page today, with why each one is a deal (for example the lowest premium in its format). Both prices and in/out of stock. Use when the user asks which Bullion Trading LLC products are featured on its deals page. Read-only.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history for either one product (its past check/wire prices) or a metal (daily closes, up to a 5-year span). Give product, or metal with optional from/to dates (default: the last 12 months). Use when the user asks how a metal's price has moved over a past period. Read-only; past data, not a forecast.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (metal history; default today)

tools.name: get_market_news
tools.description: The precious-metals market news summary for a day (default the latest): market mood, headline, a short summary, key points, source headlines with links, and the weekly recap link. Use when the user asks for the day's precious-metals market news summary. Read-only; news summary, not advice.

tools.name: plan_budget
tools.description: Best-value options for a budget in USD and a metal: which product and how many pieces fit, the payment method the total assumes (check/wire from $1,000, otherwise card/PayPal at +5%), the total and the premium over spot. Goal can favour the lowest premium, popular coins, or gift-friendly items. Before shipping and tax. Use when the user gives a budget and a metal and wants to see what fits. Read-only; it is a calculation, not a purchase.

tools.name: ratio_swap
tools.description: The current gold/silver ratio (ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys at spot), with an optional swap: give gold_oz to see the silver ounces it equals, or silver_oz for the gold ounces. Spot-to-spot only; premiums and buy-back spreads are not included. Use when the user asks for the gold/silver ratio or a spot-to-spot conversion. Read-only.

gold_oz.description: Gold ounces to convert into silver ounces

silver_oz.description: Silver ounces to convert into gold ounces

tools.name: list_best_sellers
tools.description: The best-selling products at Bullion Trading LLC, optionally for one metal. Both prices and in/out of stock. Use when the user asks which Bullion Trading LLC products sell best. Read-only.

tools.name: list_new_arrivals
tools.description: Products newly added to the Bullion Trading LLC catalog, optionally for one metal. Both prices and in/out of stock. Use when the user asks what is new in the Bullion Trading LLC catalog. Read-only.

tools.name: find_gift
tools.description: Gold and silver gift ideas for traditions and occasions (for example Pidyon HaBen or Dhanteras): what the tradition calls for, the guide page, and suggested products with both prices. Use when the user wants Bullion Trading LLC gift ideas for an occasion. Read-only.

occasion.description: Occasion slug or plain name, e.g. pidyon-haben, dhanteras, diwali, birthday, wedding, chinese new year; omit to list occasions

tools.name: get_mint_info
tools.description: About a mint or refiner (Royal Canadian Mint, PAMP, US Mint…): country, a short summary, how many products we carry and a sample with both prices. Give a slug or search words; omit both to list mints. Use when the user asks about a mint or refiner and what Bullion Trading LLC carries from it. Read-only.

mint.description: Mint slug or name, e.g. royal-canadian-mint or Royal Canadian Mint

tools.name: estimate_sell
tools.description: What Bullion Trading LLC would pay for a list of items a person wants to sell: each line a product (id, slug or URL from get_buyback_price or search_products) with a quantity, or a plain description such as "2 1965 Canadian silver dollars", "$4.40 face of 90% silver dimes" or "11 oz of .999 silver bars". Priced by the store's own rules at its posted buy-back rates (catalog price, standard coin content, or weight; descriptions are read by AI only to identify the items). Returns each line, the total, the $1,000 minimum check, and how to sell (prepaid, tracked mail-in label or walk-in). An estimate, not a locked quote. Use when the user wants to know what Bullion Trading LLC would pay for items they have (a list, a lot, or a description). Computes only; nothing is sold or sent.

product.description: Product id, slug or bulliontradingllc.com/product/… URL

text.description: Plain description of the item (metal, coin or bar, weight, year, count)

quantity.description: How many pieces (default 1 for a product)

items.description: Up to 20 items; each needs product or text

sell_method.description: mail: prepaid, tracked USPS label; walkin: our New York counter

tools.name: prepare_checkout_link
tools.description: A link the customer opens to see these products in a cart on bulliontradingllc.com, valid 24 hours. Give product ids (from search_products, get_product or find_bullion) and quantities, and optionally the delivery state to check its online rules now. The link holds no price and reserves no stock: the customer sees the live price, chooses delivery and payment, and pays on the website, where the price is locked for 10 minutes at checkout. No order exists until the customer pays. Returns the link, current prices, and notes on payment, shipping and state rules. Use when the user has chosen products to buy and wants to check out: give them the link. It places no order and reserves nothing; the user pays on the website.

product.description: Product id, slug or product URL

state.description: Delivery state, to check its online rules (the customer still chooses it in the cart)
